text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome a major milestone alongside <chrname>,
I was walking through the academy grounds with a sense of relief when――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Unwooooaaaaahhh...!!
Gwwaaaaaaahhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A groan that sounded like it echoed from the depths of the earth.
Listening closely, it seemed to be Chairwoman Akikawa's voice.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, it's you. Hmph, I was hoping to settle this matter entirely on my own, but...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelmingly formidable monster has appeared!
This is beyond anything I can handle on my own...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—These giant carrots
planted right here...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A while ago—Tazuna taught me a recipe
for highly nutritious carrot juice.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Then it struck me! We should hold an event so all the students can savor this deliciousness――
A "Carrot Stew Gathering"!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And so, we began growing carrots for the event――
and they flourished steadily――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However... the carrots cultivated through her unique farming method gradually grew colossal and went completely berserk!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Now firmly rooted to the earth as if welded into place――it stubbornly refuses to even be harvested!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
At this rate...
tonight's "Carrot Stew Gathering" will inevitably be cancelled!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...That would mean letting down the students who are looking forward to it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman Akikawa's self-reproach over disappointing the students came through painfully clear. At this point—
choice_data_list: Let's face it together! The carrots, that is!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: B-But... even if we combine our strength, these carrots are just far too powerful...!
choice_data_list: With the two of us, we can definitely do it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
........Or perhaps, with you by my side,
we might just be able to create a miracle...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mhm... Understood!
Now... we must join forces!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Uoooohhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—combining their strength, they somehow managed
to pull up the massive, deeply rooted carrots.
However—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... I'm at my limit!
Even though there's only a little left...!
choice_data_list: No... I still have strength left...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Don't overexert yourself! You mustn't have enough grip strength left to even hold a pen...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That is plenty! It might not become the ultimate carrot soup,
but we have no choice but to compromise...!
choice_data_list: That's…… that's just not who we are!
That's…… that's just not who we are!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Heh…… How uncharacteristic of me.
I had nearly forgotten!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of an Umamusume... you can summon infinite power!
That is the kind of Trainer you are!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And that... applies equally to me as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer <username>!
Channeling our final burst of power――as one!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—the hopelessly resilient
carrot squad was finally, completely,
unearthed above ground.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! So yummy~~!!
I feel power surging through me...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Good grief... A lot went down, but seeing everyone so delighted brings me absolute bliss!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: While I was away on a business trip, all of that happened...? That must have been tough...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mmm... I could not have managed this on my own this time.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You have been truly dependable!
As Chairwoman, allow me to offer my heartfelt thanks!
Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Pure modesty!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—I feel like I can truly understand how
<chrname> feels, having been supported by you all this time.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now! You must partake of the carrot soup as well!
Allow me to ladle a bowl for you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of all Umamusume――
let us continue to do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... as the night of the carrot stew party
grew late—I thought to myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For <chrname>'s sake. For all the Umamusume.
And for Chairwoman Akikawa and everyone at the academy――I resolved to keep giving it my all.
